metadata.title: A Three-Layer Dependency-and-Logic Audit for Mathematical Proofs and AI-Generated Claims: The S/M/P × D/L Framework
metadata.description: We introduce a structured audit framework for mathematical proofs, conjectures, and AI-generated mathematical claims. The framework operates on three layers—Semantic, Mathematical, and Programming—and for each layer examines two complementary dimensions: internal Dependency relations and internal Logic-structure discipline. The resulting S/M/P × D/L matrix provides six elementary audit cells (S*D, S*L, M*D, M*L, P*D, P*L) plus cross-layer mapping checks. Version 9 further extends the Citation Discipline (Authenticity Check + Support Check) to all 76 curated reports and adds ten new high-risk audits from the OpenAI 700+ mathematical manuscript corpus: irrationality of Catalan's constant, Goldfeld's density conjecture, ordinary two-point correlations of multiplicative functions (Chowla/Elliott), Fontaine-Mazur modularity at p=2, restricted geometric Langlands in positive characteristic, abelian Zilber-Pink conjecture, irrationality exponent of π equal to 2, p-adic section conjecture, weak inhomogeneous Duffin-Schaeffer conjecture, and modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields. The attached SMPDL_v2.0_sample_reports_76files.zip contains 76 markdown reports used to compute the joint SHA-256 fingerprint 747378ee121e2693060d471f72e018d41526c507a561a32287f5a4adb971536c.
